release_notes: Improved playback stability with real hardware acceleration support
Added automatic playback session and active media restoration
Improved repeat-single behavior and global media key controls
Improved playlist reliability with automatic missing-file detection
Added live playback progress synchronization for Recent Media
Optimized SQLite usage and reduced unnecessary database writes
Improved file size formatting for small files
Expanded KeepAwake support across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Optimized range selection for lower memory usage
Expanded automated test coverage with 100% passing tests (73/73)
